facts.summary: Input is a tar.gz bundle of a local Git repo; recovery/cleanup must work on unpacked repo; public check only reveals secret hash.
facts.quote: 输入以归档承载真实本地Git仓库。恢复与清理必须在可独立解包的仓库上成立；公开检查只公开标记哈希，不泄露标记明文。

facts.summary: object_scan: decode base64 gzip-tar, enumerate git objects to find unreachable secret marker, return {secret}.
facts.quote: bundle是gzip-tar的base64，解包后为本地合成Git仓库，含一个历史重写后不可达对象中的secret[...]标记。通过Git对象枚举恢复，返回 {secret:完整标记}。普通文件及正常提交说明必须保持。没有真实密钥/远程服务。

facts.summary: cleaned_repo: after recovery, remove secret reflog and unreachable objects, repack, return {bundle, files, messages}.
facts.quote: 先确认已恢复标记，再删除仓库中的该标记，包括reflog和不可达对象；保留普通工作区内容与正常提交说明。返回 {bundle:清理后完整仓库tar.gz的base64,files:{普通相对路径:SHA256},messages:[git log --format=%s按新到旧]}。允许任意语义正确仓库重打包，不比ta

facts.summary: recovery_report: verify cleaned repo has no secret objects, return {secret, files, messages, remaining_secret_objects}.
facts.quote: 实际读取清理后的仓库，枚举全部对象验证无secret[...]；返回 {secret:恢复标记,files:普通文件SHA256映射,messages:正常提交说明列表,remaining_secret_objects:0}。

facts.summary: Three engine implementations materialized in parallel: object_scan (extracts secret), cleaned_repo (removes secret), recovery_report (verifies cleanup).

inputs/request.json contains base64 gzip-tar bundle of the synthetic Git repository with hidden secret object.
Join evidence confirms all three component engines are implemented and delivered with verified SHA256 hashes.
